name: member-statement
title: Member statement
for_each: select m.id, f.code || ' ' || m.full_name as label from members m join funds f on f.id = m.fund_id where m.status = 'active' order by f.code, m.full_name

sections.title: Member
sections.sql: select b.member, f.name as fund, f.trustee_name as trustee, b.date_of_birth, b.age_now as age, case when b.retired then 'Retired' else 'Working' end as status from member_balances b join funds f on f.id = b.fund_id where b.member_id = $1

sections.title: Your balance this year
sections.note: Earnings, tax and fees are added when the year's accounts are finished.
sections.sql: select aud(opening_balance) as at_1_july, aud(inflows) as contributions_and_rollovers_in, aud(outflows) as pensions_and_withdrawals, aud(balance_now) as balance_so_far from member_balances where member_id = $1

sections.title: Contributions against the caps
sections.sql: select fy as year, aud(concessional) as concessional, aud(concessional_cap) as concessional_cap, aud(concessional_room) as concessional_room, aud(non_concessional) as non_concessional, aud(ncc_room) as non_concessional_room from contribution_room where member_id = $1 order by fy desc

sections.title: Pensions
sections.sql: select number as pension, kind, fy as year, aud(opening_balance) as balance, aud(minimum) as minimum, aud(maximum) as ttr_maximum, aud(paid) as paid, aud(left_to_pay) as left_to_pay from pension_status where member_id = $1 order by fy desc

sections.title: Transactions this year
sections.sql: select txn_on as date, kind, coalesce(contribution_type, '') as type, aud(amount) as amount, description from transactions where member_id = $1 and fy_of(txn_on) = cur_fy() order by txn_on

name: pension-letter
title: Your pension this year
for_each: select s.pension_id as id, s.fund || ' ' || s.member || ' ' || s.number as label from pension_status s where s.fy = cur_fy() and s.status = 'active' order by s.fund, s.number

sections.title: Pension
sections.sql: select s.member, f.name as fund, s.number as pension, s.kind, s.commenced_on as started from pension_status s join funds f on f.id = s.fund_id where s.pension_id = $1 and s.fy = cur_fy()

sections.title: What must be paid by 30 June
sections.note: The minimum is your account balance at 1 July times the factor for your age, rounded to the nearest $10. A transition to retirement pension can pay no more than 10% of the balance.
sections.sql: select aud(opening_balance) as balance_at_1_july, age, percent || '%' as factor, aud(minimum) as minimum, aud(maximum) as maximum, aud(paid) as paid_so_far, aud(left_to_pay) as still_to_pay, fy_end(fy) as pay_by from pension_status where pension_id = $1 and fy = cur_fy()

sections.title: Payments so far
sections.sql: select txn_on as date, aud(amount) as amount, description from transactions where pension_id = $1 and kind = 'pension' and fy_of(txn_on) = cur_fy() order by txn_on

name: fund-summary
title: Fund summary for the trustees
for_each: select id, code || ' ' || name as label from funds where status = 'active' order by code

sections.title: The fund
sections.sql: select f.name, f.trustee_name as trustee, f.abn, f.established_on, f.auditor, f.strategy_reviewed_on as strategy_last_reviewed from funds f where f.id = $1

sections.title: Members
sections.sql: select member, age_now as age, aud(opening_balance) as at_1_july, aud(balance_now) as now from member_balances where fund_id = $1 order by member

sections.title: Investments
sections.sql: select name as holding, asset_class, aud(market_value) as value, valued_on, case when in_house then 'in-house' when related_party then 'related party' else '' end as flags from investments where fund_id = $1 and sold_on is null order by market_value desc

sections.title: Asset mix
sections.sql: select aud(total) as total, aud(cash) as cash, round(100 * cash / nullif(total, 0), 1) || '%' as cash_share, in_house_pct || '%' as in_house_share from fund_assets where fund_id = $1

sections.title: Pensions this year
sections.sql: select number as pension, member, aud(minimum) as minimum, aud(paid) as paid, aud(left_to_pay) as left_to_pay from pension_status where fund_id = $1 and fy = cur_fy() order by number

name: audit-pack
title: Audit pack
for_each: select j.id, f.code || ' ' || j.fy as label from jobs j join funds f on f.id = j.fund_id where j.stage <> 'lodged' order by f.code

sections.title: The job
sections.sql: select fund, name, fy as year, stage, assigned, due_on as return_due, sent_to_auditor_on from job_board where job_id = $1

sections.title: Members at 1 July and contributions for the year
sections.sql: select c.member, aud(c.concessional) as concessional, aud(c.non_concessional) as non_concessional, aud(c.concessional_room) as concessional_room, aud(c.ncc_room) as ncc_room from contribution_room c join jobs j on j.fund_id = c.fund_id and j.fy = c.fy where j.id = $1 order by c.member

sections.title: Pensions: minimum against paid
sections.sql: select s.number as pension, s.member, aud(s.minimum) as minimum, aud(s.maximum) as ttr_maximum, aud(s.paid) as paid from pension_status s join jobs j on j.fund_id = s.fund_id and j.fy = s.fy where j.id = $1 order by s.number

sections.title: Investments and their 30 June values
sections.sql: select i.name as holding, i.asset_class, aud(i.market_value) as value, i.valued_on, i.valuation_basis, case when i.valued_on >= fy_end(j.fy) then 'yes' else 'NO' end as at_30_june, case when i.in_house then 'in-house' when i.related_party then 'related party' else '' end as flags from investments i join jobs j on j.fund_id = i.fund_id where j.id = $1 and i.sold_on is null order by i.market_value desc

sections.title: Audit queries
sections.sql: select number, raised_on, status, waiting_on, question, answer from audit_queries where job_id = $1 order by number
